728-1445-4871-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
728-1445-4871-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

232-678-5686.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

4417-4551-8089.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1981-2034-2415-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-6823.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3062-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3062-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Pir.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3698-4907-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
3698-4907-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
When Tatterkite enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

457-5159-5491-7292.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-5159-5491-7292.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

1012-2292-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1012-2292-4871-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1308-1409-3128.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve the Skullport Merchant trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2811-3490-4659-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2811-3490-4659-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

729-1170-1329-1414.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Oak Guardian.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

147-554-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-554-5686.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1657-6602.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Tromell.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Repeat from step 2.

628-6487.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls seven or more creatures.
628-6487.description:
Cast Canker Abomination by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
Canker Abomination dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

549-1365-4853-5226--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-4853-5226--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Lithatog's first ability by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4770-5184-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
4770-5184-5554.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1477-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
1477-5365.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on another creature you control.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue aritfact token.
Repeat.

2096-2615-2773.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, God-Pharaoh's Gift triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 4/4 Zombie with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, causing the Tree of Perdition token to deal damage equal to its power to the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2430-2805-3415-5218.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by discarding Kiri-Onna.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Kiri-Onna and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Cast Kiri-Onna from exile by discarding Petals of Insight.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Petals of Insight and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Kiri-Onna enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight from exile by discarding Kiri-Onna.
Repeat from step 2.

2510-4489-5081.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card with morph or megamorph in hand.
You have a creature card exiled by Semblance Anvil.
2510-4489-5081.description:
Cast the creature with morph or megamorph for its morph or megamorph cost by paying {0}, putting it on the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down creature face-up, allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Repeat.

719-1707-2818-4302.notablePrerequisites:
Floating Shield attached to Bishop of Wings.
"Black" chosen with Floating Shield.
"Angel" chosen with Xenograft.
You control an additional creature with toughness equal to one.
You have a way to deal damage to the creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
719-1707-2818-4302.description:
Deal damage to a creature you control with toughness equal to one.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The creature dies as an Angel due to Xenograft, triggering Bishop of Wings' second ability, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, as an Angel due to Xenograft, triggering Bishop of Wings' first ability, causing you to gain four life.
Last Laugh triggers, dealing 1 damage to each creature except Bishop of WIngs, as well as each player.
The Spirit dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-3634-4563.description:
Cast Everflowing Chalice by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Venser.
Venser enters the battlefield, returning Everflowing Chalice to your hand.
Repeat.

913-2034-2577.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

430-1061-3268.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
Any equipment attached to Kemba.
430-1061-3268.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Kemba triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator for each Equipment attached to Kemba.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
